_comment: Tier-1 known-phishing snapshot, checked entirely on-device (lib/engine/blocklist.ts). Regenerate with `npm run blocklist:build`, which merges data/blocklist.seed.json with public feeds (URLhaus, OpenPhish). This committed copy = seed only, so the app ships with a working blocklist even if the build is never run. `hosts` block a whole site; `urls` block one path.
